Actress Karishma Tanna reveals son's Sanskrit name on Janmashtami

Actress Karishma Tanna revealed her son's Sanskrit name on the occasion of Janmashtami. The name, which was not previously disclosed, was announced by Tanna. The child was born on Guru Purnima. The actress also explained the meaning of the name.
